statistical_methodology.cv_protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed) grouped by family_id, with TF-IDF + balanced LogisticRegression refitted inside every fold. Stratum-controlled probes restrict to shared strata and apply inverse-stratum-count sample weights during fitting.
statistical_methodology.plus_minus_definition: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of pooled out-of-fold (OOF) ROC-AUC across the 10 random CV fold-assignment seeds (42..51). Quantifies CV split-randomization variability on the fixed finite dataset; NOT standard error of the mean and NOT generalization uncertainty to unseen data.

ci_95_definitions.bootstrap_95ci_seed42: Stratified percentile bootstrap (B=1,000, [2.5, 97.5] percentiles, resampling rows with replacement within each is_synthetic class) on seed=42 OOF predictions (retained for direct continuity with Batch 3). Note: centered on a single CV split (seed=42) rather than the 10-seed mean.
ci_95_definitions.bootstrap_95ci_mean_oof: Stratified percentile bootstrap (B=1,000, [2.5, 97.5] percentiles) on 10-seed averaged OOF probabilities per row (centered on the multi-seed ensemble OOF score).
ci_95_definitions.cluster_bootstrap_95ci_mean_oof: Family-cluster stratified percentile bootstrap (B=1,000, resampling family_id clusters with replacement within class) on 10-seed averaged OOF probabilities.
ci_95_definitions.generalization_caveat: Bootstrap CIs on OOF predictions estimate finite-sample score uncertainty conditional on the fixed training corpus; they do NOT capture model-fitting variance or true out-of-sample generalization error to unseen real-world distributions, which requires held-out/OOD evaluation.

statistical_methodology.cohort_comparability_warning: Cohorts differ in synthetic sample size (N_syn = 50, 150, 200, 261, 461) and matched-stratum coverage. Larger N_syn provides more positive examples per fold and mechanically increases linear TF-IDF separability; different matched-stratum subsets evaluate on different real/synthetic rows. Do NOT claim statistically significant improvement from non-comparable cohort AUC comparisons.

brand_detection_definition.primary_unified_definition: evaluate_codemix_and_entity_diversity(..., known_brands=list(DEFAULT_KNOWN_BRANDS), brand_registry=merged_b1_to_b4_registry), which combines _CANONICAL_BRAND_ALIASES + DEFAULT_KNOWN_BRANDS (REAL_BD_BRANDS + FICTIONAL_PILOT_BRANDS) + Batch 1-4 brand registries + row metadata + CamelCase brand detector consistently across eligible_train and all 5 synthetic cohorts.
brand_detection_definition.difference_vs_default_diversity_fn: Default evaluate_codemix_and_entity_diversity (without known_brands=DEFAULT_KNOWN_BRANDS) omits REAL_BD_BRANDS (misclassifying real eligible_train brands) and omits Pilot brand 'নীড়হাট' (NeerHaat, syn_p2_c_0003), inflating Pilot/Full Combined brandless count by +1 row (5->6 on Pilot; 84->85 on Full Combined prior to B4).
brand_detection_definition.difference_vs_schema_brand_regex: schema.compile_brand_regex only matches Bengali suffixes (-ের/-ে/-তে/-কে/-র) and misses '-য়' on Batch 1 syn_b1_0035 ('শাপলাসেবায়'), whereas codemix_diversity Bengali alias matching catches it.
